final: WITH c AS (SELECT f.rating AS rating, COUNT(*) AS n FROM inventory i JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id GROUP BY f.rating), a AS (SELECT AVG(n) AS avg_n FROM c WHERE n IS NOT NULL), k AS (SELECT c.rating, c.n, a.avg_n FROM c JOIN a ON a.avg_n IS NOT NULL WHERE c.n > a.avg_n) SELECT SUM(n) AS total_count, AVG(n - avg_n) AS avg_diff FROM k
